The '''Tragan Cluster''', or the '''Tragan sector''', was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Some of the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] included in the Tragan Cluster were [[Shaum Hii/Legends|Shaum Hii]] and [[Ord Traga]]. The sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Brinkan]].
